name: cle/bead-timeline
title: Story beads
description: Milestones as clay beads on a cord, the brand's "connecting the dots" motif. Tap a bead to read its story.

default.title: Cleveland Big Data begins
default.body: Doug Meil starts a Hadoop user group, years before anyone had "data engineer" on a business card.

default.title: Cleveland AI forms
default.body: A second group starts as machine learning moves out of the lab and into everyday software.

default.title: CLE AI & DATA
default.body: In November the two groups merge. AI and data had stopped being separate conversations.

default.title: A nonprofit, officially
default.body: We incorporate and become a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit. Still run by volunteers, still free to attend, and now donations are tax-deductible.
